title: Status script setup, refresh, restart and failure

install.basis: real candidate source checkout in its repository virtual environment

terminal.program: Talaria via POSIX PTY on macOS

actions:
The supplied status starter runs as a real script. Its unavailable spending data is explicitly labelled; adding a line to the script appears on the next actual refresh.
The configuration view saves interval7 while identifying effective-now2 and takes-effect-on-restart. Relaunching the real application reports effective7 with user provenance and the same script command.
An intentional script exit1 displays a visible status-command failure; the composer remains editable. No unavailable value is manufactured as a measured zero.
wire-evidence.jsonl: complete gapless interval of26 frames and12 outgoing requests; no event filter applied.
wire-config-before-restart.jsonl: complete gapless interval of26 frames and12 outgoing requests; no event filter applied.
wire-config-after-restart.jsonl: complete gapless interval of28 frames and12 outgoing requests; no event filter applied.

expected.text: Configure the supplied real status script, observe and edit its output, exercise apply/restart behavior and show a failing script while keeping status and composer usable.

actual:
All selected frames were visually reviewed against these clauses. Every frame has its capture-time text twin and sidecar. Complete derived wire intervals preserve every event type, and no MoA event occurs in these runs.
Clause 1: pass: The supplied status starter runs as a real script. Its unavailable spending data is explicitly labelled; adding a line to the script appears on the next actual refresh. (https://github.com/infiquetra/talaria/issues/143)
Clause 2: pass: The configuration view saves interval7 while identifying effective-now2 and takes-effect-on-restart. Relaunching the real application reports effective7 with user provenance and the same script command. (https://github.com/infiquetra/talaria/issues/143)
Clause 3: pass: An intentional script exit1 displays a visible status-command failure; the composer remains editable. No unavailable value is manufactured as a measured zero. (https://github.com/infiquetra/talaria/issues/143)
